article.headline: Prince rallies No. 23 Nebraska women past Creighton 55-45
article.description: — Britt Prince scored 12 of her 18 points in the second half and contributed six assists and No. 23 Nebraska turned away Creighton 55-45 on Sunday.
article.linkText: Prince rallies No. 23 Nebraska women past Creighton 55-45
article.story: OMAHA, Neb. -- — Britt Prince scored 12 of her 18 points in the second half and contributed six assists and No. 23 Nebraska turned away Creighton 55-45 on Sunday. Nebraska didn't get the lead to double figures until Prince hit a 3-pointer to make it 51-41 with less than three minutes to play. Allison Weidner added 11 points for the Cornhuskers (6-0), who held Creighton to six field goals in the second half. Mya Moore led the Bluejays (4-2) with 12 points. In the second half, they were 1 of 10 on 3s and shot 31%, finishing 4 of 20 behind the arc and 31% overall. Logan Nissley hit a 3 for the last basket of the first quarter for a 15-13 Nebraska lead. Weidner and Nissley hit 3s in the middle of the second quarter to give the Cornhuskers the lead for good, 23-19. It was 29-26 at the half, Nebraska hurt by 2-of-6 shooting at the foul line and 11 turnovers. The Bluejays got within one in the third quarter but with two baskets by Amiah Hargrove and Prince, Nebraska led 44-37 entering the fourth quarter. Up next Nebraska: Home against Kansas City on Tuesday.
